design_philosophy: Fresh, raw, and highly energetic. Breaks the smooth, corporate 'SaaS' mold by utilizing neo-brutalist principles: flat pastel backgrounds, thick stark black borders, hard offset shadows, and bold expressive typography. This perfectly captures the Gen Z college audience's preference for authenticity, fun, and anti-corporate design.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-[#121212]
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[#121212]

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Tetris Grid for landing/onboarding. Asymmetrical, varied column spans. Dashboard/App uses dense Control Room grid but with hard borders separating panes.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding. p-6 or p-8 inside bordered containers. gap-6 to gap-8 between grid items.
layout_and_spacing.borders_and_shadows: Neo-Brutalist standard: 2px solid #121212 borders on all interactive elements and containers. Use hard offset shadows instead of soft blurs (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#121212]). Hover states increase translation and shadow spread (e.g., -translate-y-1 shadow-[6px_6px_0px_#121212]).
layout_and_spacing.corners: Sharp (rounded-none) to emphasize the brutalist, raw structure.

components.buttons: Thick 2px borders, solid pastel or primary background, high contrast text. Hover must translate X and Y and expand the hard shadow. Example: bg-[#FF49DB] text-[#121212] font-bold border-2 border-[#121212] shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#121212] hover:-translate-y-1 hover:-translate-x-1 hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_#121212] transition-all duration-200.
components.cards: Flat surfaces (white or pastel) with 2px black border and offset black shadow. Internal padding p-6.
components.inputs: Large text, thick 2px black border, p-4. focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 focus:border-[#2563EB] focus:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#2563EB] transition-all.
components.video_chat_interface: The main video grid should be pure and simple. Videos fill their container (object-cover) with a stark 2px black border separating users. Overlay controls use high-contrast solid blocks, NO blurry glassmorphism. Use solid white/black backgrounds for control bars.
components.chat_bubbles: Sharp edges, flat colors. Same college = Yellow, Same WiFi = Mint, Cross College = Lilac.
components.shadcn_customization: Strip all default rounded-md and shadow-sm classes from Shadcn. Replace with rounded-none border-2 border-[#121212] shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#121212].

motion.strategy: Snappy, spring-based animations. No slow, floaty fades. When connecting to a peer, use an energetic slide-up or hard scale-in.
motion.hover: Translate elements quickly with hard shadows expanding to simulate physical button pressing or lifting.

accessibility.contrast: Extremely high due to neo-brutalist stark black text/borders against pastel or white backgrounds.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='video-toggle').

media_and_assets.icons: lucide-react with strokeWidth={2.5} or 3 for a chunky, bold look matching the borders.

images.description: Abstract pastel geometric shapes with soft lighting. Use as an accent background for the landing page or OTP login screen.
A group of students sitting at a table studying/writing. Use in the Study Buddy matching feature or as an onboarding graphic.
A group of friends happily posing outdoors. Use for the 'Find Friends' or 'Cross College' networking feature.
A group of people standing around each other. Use for community/history/friends list empty states or banners.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use `lucide-react` for chunky icons (strokeWidth={2.5}).
Override default Shadcn UI classes. Strip `rounded-md`, `shadow-sm`, and soft borders. Replace with `rounded-none`, `border-2 border-[#121212]`, and `shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#121212]`.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the landing page and OTP layout. Use Shadcn strictly for interactive pieces (dialogs, dropdowns, inputs) but heavily restyle them.
Add Bricolage Grotesque and Outfit from Google Fonts to the index.html or global css.
For the Video Chat interface, prioritize the video feeds taking up maximum screen real estate. Controls should float in stark, high-contrast flat-colored blocks.
Implement the 3 connection modes using strong color-coding (Same College = Mint, Same WiFi = Yellow, Cross College = Lilac).
Include `data-testid` on ALL buttons, inputs, and toggle switches.
Never use placehold.it or dummyimage. Use ONLY the media URLs provided in this file.
